title: 03919 - B1916/039190
models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution: Manually discharge Gateway backup-battery to reset system
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the 2018 Audi A4, A5, Q5 and/or Q7, follow this Technical Service Bulletin:
91 SOS warning displayed in instrument cluster, DTC B191604 stored in the gateway control module 2051664
